extract_batch over URI inputs

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final inputs = await Future.wait((jsonDecode(r'[{"kind":"uri","uri":"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf"},{"kind":"uri","uri":"https://example.com/text/fake_text.txt"}]') as List<dynamic>).map((element) => createExtractInputFromJson(json: jsonEncode(element))));
    final result = await XbergBridge.extractBatch(inputs);
    for (final result in result.results) {
      stdout.writeln(result.content);
    }
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
